diagram_math_checks.objects: Real-to-real projection X_t(y)=y-2ty exp(-y^2); horizontal coordinate y, vertical coordinate X_t(y); t=1/4,1/2,1.
diagram_math_checks.relations: At t=1/4, X_t prime >=1/2>0. At t=1/2, X_t prime(0)=0; away from zero the derivative is positive since exp(-y^2)<1 and 2 y^2 exp(-y^2)>0. At t=1 the central derivative equals -1, showing decreasing central branch, not local noninjectivity.
